task_context: Implement per-category retry backoff in error_policy.decide(): RetryWithBackoff categories use delay = 1*2^n and honor a server Retry-After hint.

expected_findings.description: hint-cap inversion: min(60, max(delay, hint)) caps our own exponential backoff, contradicting the docstring (the 60s cap is meant for the hint only). Fires only when hint_delay_seconds is not None.
